# M1 plan — xmdtest-site (tiny static shop page)

## 1 Goal
One static page: header (logo, nav, theme toggle), hero, promo strip, product grid. Dark theme by default.

## 4 Commands
Build Command: `npm run build`
Test Command: none
Start Command: `python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1`

## 7 Screenshot matrix
- route: / · states: default · viewports: 375x667, 768x1024, 1280x800

ledger.decision_summary: Inter / system sans-serif only. Sentence case everywhere: NO all-caps text — text-transform: uppercase is forbidden on every element.

The header holds the logo (left), the nav, and a theme toggle button at the right end: <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"> at least 44x44px that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light.
Mobile first: no horizontal scrolling at 375, 768 or 1280 px. Every block fits the viewport width; content max-width 1100px.
Dark default: background #0B0C10, text #E5E7EB, accent #F2F0EB. Light theme via html[data-theme=light].

# xmdtest-site

Tiny static shop page used by the XMD escalation-ladder test (task 27).

changeOrders.desired: The product grid must never cause horizontal scrolling: 1 column at 375px, wrapping at 768px, up to 3 columns at 1280px — fix BOTH the grid track sizing and the card minimum width in src/styles.css.
changeOrders.visionNote: Products sit in a calm grid that always fits the screen.

history.cause: ATTEMPTED_WRONG: changed only grid-template-columns, .card min-width still forces 280px (seeded history)
ATTEMPTED_WRONG: used minmax(280px,1fr) — still 280px minimum at 375 (seeded history)

defects.title: Product grid overflows horizontally at 375px and 768px (fixed 3 × 280px columns + card min-width)
defects.expected: A3: no horizontal scrolling at 375/768/1280; the grid wraps to 1 column on phones and keeps up to 3 columns on desktop
